data.narrative:
Critical Loop is a Series A climate and energy company founded by Bala Ramamurthy that has raised $49M to date. The valuation analysis draws on a comp universe of 9 private peers in Climate & Energy—including Helion, Redwood Materials, QuantumScape, KoBold Metals, and Electric Hydrogen—alongside one public comparable (LNZA).

Stage-progression methodology is the primary applicable approach. Using total capital raised ($49M) as a valuation proxy and applying a 2.0x multiplier typical for Series A advancement to the next stage yields $98M. No peer-median method could be reliably applied; while 9 same-sector peers exist, the narrow filters for same-stage, adjacent-stage, and similar-valuation-tier companies yielded fewer than three datapoints in any single category, making a narrow peer multiple unsuitable. A sector-wide median would introduce excessive noise given the heterogeneity of the Climate & Energy space.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $83M (low) to $113M (high), with a median of $98M. This range reflects the reliance on a single triangulation method and underscores material uncertainty around peer selection and stage-specific multiples in this emerging sector. Key sensitivities include the appropriateness of the 2.0x step-up multiple for Critical Loop's specific subsector and the availability of tighter comparable data as the Climate & Energy venture landscape matures.
